unsupported.persistent_note_ids: Ardour NotePtr does not expose event ID in Lua.
unsupported.midi_cc_editing: Model/persistence semantics not yet integration verified.
unsupported.midi_sysex_editing: Event data buffer and safe construction not sufficiently bound.
unsupported.mpe_editing: No verified MPE model edit adapter.
unsupported.render_stems: SimpleExport exposes master output, not stem selection.
unsupported.time_stretch: Offline helper needs safe asynchronous job adapter.
unsupported.pitch_shift: Offline helper needs safe asynchronous job adapter.
unsupported.crossfades: Dedicated deterministic crossfade adapter not verified.
unsupported.session_open_create: Live GUI session replacement/creation not verified safely.
unsupported.scan_plugins: Inventory available; forcing plugin scan not bound safely.
unsupported.import_audio: Editor import arguments and precise insertion not integration verified.
unsupported.full_human_edit_revision: Bridge revision observes supported state; no complete Ardour generation API.
unsupported.general_atomic_transactions: Ardour abort_reversible_command discards history, not edits.
unsupported.timecode_conversion: Typed drop-frame/offset conversion adapter pending validation.
unsupported.markers: Range primitives found; inherited Location ID returned 0 in native 9.8 probe; safe addressing/undo adapter pending.
unsupported.punch_configuration: Existing location/config bindings require additional verification.
